title: Kanhoji Angre
context: Prachyam · Kanhoji Angre · Selected motion work
desc: Character scenes, coastal maps and naval motion design for Prachyam.
lead: I worked on art direction and motion design for Prachyam’s film on Kanhoji Angre, with character scenes, coastal maps and naval sequences.
body: Prachyam’s film follows Kanhoji Angre and his role in Maratha naval history. This selection brings together my character scenes, coastal maps and naval sequences.
detail: My work covered creative direction, visual design and motion treatment across the selected sequences. The accompanying showcase includes Sambhaji Maharaj, Maharani Tarabai and Kanhoji Angre, alongside scenes of the naval fleets.
contribution: Handled creative direction and visual design for the selected work.
Worked on composition and motion treatment across character, map and naval sequences.
summary: I worked on art direction and motion design for Prachyam’s film on Kanhoji Angre, with character scenes, coastal maps and naval sequences.
